scope: Individual saved-row reconstruction only; no frozen-cohort comparison or physical validation.

definitions.age: Fractions of each individual terminal age with adjacent-event brackets; these are not common cohort ages.
definitions.extent: Largest occupied lattice-coordinate extent includes end cells; center span is (extent - 1) times dxUm.
definitions.occupancy: Occupied sites and cell volume exclude partial fill; neither is total accreted mass.
definitions.warm: Per-row open intervals, width exposure and size brackets; matched persistence contrasts remain pending.
definitions.facet: Independently reconstructed initial and terminal spans/counts; no absent-arm contrasts or catch-up claim.
definitions.cold: Terminal central-plane rings only; exact-tip plateaus and common-age comparisons remain pending.

frozenCohortComparisons.reason: Retained identities are exercises and historical inputs, not new BLD results.
